journey.title: Understand why an agent's program failed, and correct it
journey.purpose: The spine of the console. An agent submitted a program, it stopped, and a human needs to find out why without reconstructing the agent's reasoning. Every surface appears once, in the order a real operator meets them, ending with a correction that becomes evidence rather than a private fix.

steps.intent: See that something failed and which class of failure it was, without opening anything.
Land on the failing line with the failure summary already read. Learn that pre-flight validation rejected an argument and that no request was ever issued.
Hover the offending binding to see its typed signature from the proto descriptor, and find the field name the program should have used.
Confirm the binding's declared effect and required permissions, and check whether the session that ran it held a satisfying grant.
Read the materialization ledger for the calls that did succeed, to judge whether the program was spending context well before it stopped.
Fork the program and correct the field. Markers become predictive and come from the same validator the API uses, so the editor agrees with the runtime.
Submit the fork into a fresh session and watch invocations stream in as they complete.
See the fork in the corpus, marked operator-submitted and linked to the agent program it came from, so the correction is legible as evidence without being counted as agent behavior.

claims.statement: From the dashboard, an operator reaches the failing line and its stated cause within two navigations.
claims.rationale: This is the most common path through the console. Every additional hop is paid by every operator on every failure.

claims.statement: The journey completes without leaving this scenario for agent-manager.
claims.rationale: The program and its typed failure are self-sufficient evidence. Needing the agent's transcript to understand a failure would mean the program record is incomplete.

claims.statement: The corrected fork is discoverable in the corpus with its provenance and ancestry intact.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-008. A fix that leaves no linked record teaches nothing; a fix miscounted as agent behavior corrupts what corpus mining measures.
